programs.title: Bloomberg Open Interest

programs.title: Bloomberg Tech
programs.desc: Bloomberg Tech is the only daily live technology program with a focus on breaking news, market-moving reporting and analysis of global technology companies and stories. The program brings the audience interviews from the biggest names in the business, offering in-depth analysis and critical insights.

programs.title: Bloomberg ETF IQ
programs.desc: Bloomberg ETF IQ focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry; Katie Greifeld, Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas are joined by leaders in this market.

programs.title: Bloomberg: Balance of Power

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Kristalina Georgieva on the IMF's Role as Global Truth Teller
programs.desc: On this week's Leaders with Francine Lacqua, she speaks with International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva about the IMF's role as a truth teller for the global economy, the importance of trust in making difficult reforms and why leaders must protect the most vulnerable while preparing for a world of repeated shocks.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast

programs.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Rolls-Royce Chief Executive Officer Tufan Erginbilgiç about confronting the company's weaknesses with data-driven honesty and setting a clear, granular strategy to transform performance and culture; he reflects on the responsibility of restoring one of Britain's most important industrial brands.

programs.title: Bloomberg The Asia Trade
programs.desc: Bringing global investors everything you need to know as the trading day begins in Asia; Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping markets, from tech, to geopolitics, and the world's energy transition.
